formulaNotes: No Parfum declared; E3 cut at Sodium Benzoate (8); prominent = 2-7.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) (ether/sulfonate type) with prominent buffer(s) Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3) and no prominent reinforcing strong anionic -> moderate. Dead Sea salt (9) and silt (19) are not routes.

conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful system: prominent Hydroxypropyl Guar HPTC (6) alone; Glycerin (11) late. No silicone, lipid or pearlizer -> moderate at most.
counterSignals: cleansing-led short formula; guar is the only conditioning route

weightPotential.rationale: low: single guar polymer facing a moderate C1 reset; no persistent system.

depositionLoad.rationale: Single deposition family: one HP guar (6).

persistence.rationale: Single guar in rinse-off is weakly retained; no silicone/lipid.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: low: single guar polymer facing a moderate C1 reset; no persistent system.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: only one deposition family, no reinforcing route (W2 not triggered); essential oils excluded.

focusPrimary.rationale: Blind pass: claims hidden, so no positioned job can be confirmed; Piroctone Olamine (5) makes scalp_active compatible with an E2 dandruff claim; light formula also compatible with clarifying.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty default; a secondary needs distinct exact-product positioning (Section 8), not visible blind.

usageRole.rationale: Default regular (Section 9); every non-default trigger needs a claim graded moderate/high, hidden in the blind pass. treatment fires with an E2 dandruff claim (U3).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Blind: no positioning visible (SC1). Formula half CSA FAILS (prominent E4 routes: none). Even explicit sensitive/dry positioning would give not_targeted (CSA, missing prominent listed route).
counterSignals: Tea tree and citrus essential oils (12-18) after the preservative cut

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine (5) (Section 11) -> supported (formula only; dandruff target still needs an E2 dandruff claim, S-DANDRUFF/R17.3).

formulaFacts.role: E3 marker (first listed preservative; no Parfum)
